title: rea.slot_manifest/v2
description: Discovery and admission declaration for a user-installed, out-of-process external tool. This contract extends the rea.provider_slot_manifest/v1 inventory by reusing its roles and referencing versioned provider, request and result contracts. Host policy, local bindings and conformance receipts authorize use independently of this document.

$comment.description: Optional author SPDX notice. ViewPoint-authored manifests use AGPL-3.0-only. A third-party manifest may declare its own licence here. The upstream tool licence belongs in upstream.licence_id.

slot_id.description: Stable external tool identifier, independent of its provider roles.

status.description: Declaration state. not_installed is discovery-only and may carry pending pins for fixture exchange. registered identifies a pinned release. The host computes operation availability from the local binding and policy.

upstream.description: Release identity and licence review inputs.

provider_ref.description: Identity and pins of the reused provider record and implementation.

contract_refs.description: Request and result pins keyed by existing provider role.

operations.description: Declared operations keyed by operation id.

capabilities.description: Release support, readiness probes and adapter identity.

perception.description: Perception levels and outside-capsule observation sources.

comparison.description: Comparator identity and host comparison policy inputs.

evidence.description: Projection to the shared evidence-store receipt.

conformance.description: Host fixtures, controls, entry points and qualification checks.

discovery.description: Passive searchable catalog and help data.

sha256.description: Concrete lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 pin. The all-zero placeholder is reserved.

pendingPin.description: Concrete digest or null pending verification.

opId.description: Operation id local to the slot.

argv.description: Ordered literal argument words passed directly to the selected executable.

effects.description: Host effect ids in domain.action:scope form.

source_url.description: Upstream HTTPS source URL. A reserved .invalid placeholder identifies a pending coordinate in discovery-only data.

version.description: Upstream release version, or unpinned while discovery-only.

licence_id.description: Declared SPDX licence identifier or expression, subject to host review.

licence_evidence_refs.description: Coordinates supporting the upstream licence declaration.

component_notices.description: References to applicable component notices and attributions.

user_installed.description: The user obtains and installs the external tool independently of ViewPoint distribution.

provider_id.description: Provider identity used by the slot request.

provider_revision.description: Provider revision, or unpinned while discovery-only.

provider_sha256.description: Expected canonical digest of the provider record.

implementation_sha256.description: Expected installed implementation digest under the provider contract.

concreteProvider.description: Concrete provider revision, record pin and implementation pin.

concreteExchange.description: Concrete schema pins for both sides of the exchange.

request_schema_ref.description: Versioned base request schema URI without a role selector.

request_digest.description: Expected digest of the request schema.

result_schema_ref.description: Versioned base result schema URI without a role selector.

result_digest.description: Expected digest of the result schema.

execution_profile.description: Requested profile. Either exchange v1 reference restricts the row to offline_fixture. external_process requires pinned v2 or later exchange and provider contracts and independent host admission.

argv_prefix.description: Literal words immediately following the local executable.

driver_location.description: The driving agent and host runner operate from outside the capsule.

executable_binding.description: The executable comes from the user-selected local binding and is launched out of process.

argv_prefix.description: Literal words immediately following the local executable.

cwd_policy.description: The host supplies the attempt scratch directory as cwd.

env_allowlist.description: Requested environment variable names, intersected with host policy.

alternates.description: Optional alternate of a different kind, inheriting the binding, driver, cwd and environment policy.

binding.description: Operation mapping to an approved transport or host composition.

typed_args.description: Argument mappings resolved by the admitted adapter.

type.description: Expected adapter input type. Path denotes a host-materialized artifact path.

position.description: Zero-based ordinal among appended typed arguments.

kind.description: Invoke an admitted tool on the external stdio server.

native_call.description: Opaque adapter call identifier, or null for a host-only binding.

id.description: Stable published operation name. The conform router segment is reserved by the compiler.

role.description: Existing provider role used for the exchange.

input_ref.description: Full request URI plus the provider-role selector. The compiler requires exact agreement with the matching contract row and role.

output_ref.description: Full result URI plus the provider-role selector. The compiler requires exact agreement with the matching contract row and role.

required_grants.description: Host grant ids that must cover execution.

max_output_bytes.description: Requested cap on output bytes accepted from the operation.

limits.description: Attempt ceilings capped by host policy.

mode.description: Declared retry class, subject to qualification.

on_interrupt.description: Handling of an interrupted attempt under the declared retry class.

prerequisite_probes.description: Readiness checks executed only after a binding and probe authorization exist.

argv.description: Literal arguments for the selected executable.

effects.description: Effects a host probe grant must cover.

requires_binding.description: The host must have authorized the local executable before probing.

optional_features.description: Features requiring their own qualification before use.

adapter_sha256.description: Expected adapter digest, independently verified by the host.

provenance.description: Adapter origin for the licence fence.

adapter_identity.description: Identity and origin of the qualified adapter.

level.description: Perception level exercised by the source.

producer.description: Declared producer identity verified by the host at capture.

outside_capsule.description: The observer operates from outside the capsule.

required.description: This source needs a shared vision-pool lease.

owner.description: Owner of the shared pool contract.

ticket_field.description: Evidence observation field for the host's actual lease id.

vision_pool.description: Mandatory lease declaration for a vision source.

visionSource.description: Matches a source by its declared vision level.

required_level.description: Minimum level for the declared operations.

optional_levels.description: Higher levels the caller may request subject to grants.

observation_sources.description: Sources used for the declared observation levels.

observable_channels.description: Recorded value, error, timing or other observation channels.

state_domain.description: Scope of state bound into the recording.

effects.description: Effects required for record and replay, covered by their operation declarations.

determinism_modes.description: Declared adapter replay modes, resolved to evidence modes through a qualified host policy and witnessed controls.

freshness_inputs.description: Inputs bound into the freshness check.

comparator_id.description: Host comparator identity recorded in the evidence verdict.

policy_ref.description: Reference resolved to the host-admitted comparator policy.

coverage_requirements.description: Policy requirements keyed by channel or coverage dimension.

tolerance_units.description: Units of declared tolerance dimensions, or none for an exact policy.

source.description: Declared source of waiver records, subject to host approval.

binds.description: Values each approved waiver must bind.

stale.description: A stale waiver fails its qualification check.

shared_schema_ref.description: ViewPoint_Tools EVIDENCE_RECEIPT_SCHEMA adapter reference. A pending reference limits evidence use to fixtures.

required_rea_fields.description: REA evidence profile groups required when applicable to the operation and its policy.

artifact_roles.description: Roles of payloads retained by the evidence store.

retention.description: Requested retention class, subject to evidence-store policy.

visibility.description: Requested disclosure class. Raw vision lease ids remain private.

negative_control_refs.description: References to host-owned controls that must reach their intended contrasts.

supported_entry_points.description: Mandatory agent-facing call interfaces included in parity testing. Router discovery is unconditional.

required_checks.description: Declared kit checks. Host policy can require additional applicable checks from the bank.

operation_descriptions.description: Public description for each declared operation id.

examples.description: Optional public usage specimens, validated before publication.

args.description: Arguments conforming to that operation's generated public input schema.
